name: Frame Extractor
subtitle: Pull stills out of any video
description: Unsigned Frame Extractor builds for signing with Feather.

apps.name: Frame Extractor
apps.subtitle: Pull stills out of any video
apps.localizedDescription: Mark frames while a video plays, then save every one of them to your photo library at the video's own resolution. Videos can be chosen in the app or handed over from the share sheet, Files, AirDrop and frameextractor:// links.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Frame Extractor saves the frames you extract to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Frame Extractor reads the videos you choose and removes frames from your library when you delete them.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 1.6.0 (build 87) — unsigned, ready to sign with Feather.
